name: Courtyards & Verandahs
description: Explore Sri Lanka through architecture, gardens and the spaces where everyday life meets design.
heading: Architecture, gardens and time to linger
advice: Choose small heritage stays and allow time for gardens and architectural visits. Confirm opening arrangements before adding private properties to the itinerary.

name: Cycling in Sri Lanka Tour
description: Discuss an active route through village roads, rural scenery and the landscapes you want to explore by bicycle.
heading: Village roads at your own pace
advice: Discuss daily distances, elevation, bicycle fit, helmets and support transport. Cycling sections should be chosen with a local operator around your fitness and road conditions.

name: Everlasting Summer in Lanka
description: Bring together leisurely sightseeing, garden visits and time to unwind along the way.
heading: Gardens, hill air and the coast
advice: Leave a full transfer day between the hills and coast. Ask for garden visits and restful afternoons rather than filling every day with excursions.

name: Experiential East
description: Look towards the eastern coast for a journey combining sea views, local culture and slower days.
heading: Culture followed by coastal days
advice: Build in a full final travel day from the east. Choose water activities locally according to sea conditions, and discuss whether an extra overnight stop would suit your departure.

name: Fabulous Sri Lanka
description: Ask about a shared journey through the island’s varied landscapes and cultural places.
heading: A shared introduction to the island
advice: This is an idea for travelling together, not a scheduled group departure. Ask about group size, room sharing, departure dates and whether a private version is available.

name: Love Songs of Ceylon
description: Shape a trip for two around quiet stays, beautiful scenery and time together.
heading: Room for two, and room to slow down
advice: Prioritise fewer hotel changes, private time and a room style you both enjoy. Special meals, room upgrades and celebrations need separate confirmation.

name: Meditation & Yoga
description: Explore a gentler travel rhythm with time for yoga, reflection and restful surroundings.
heading: A gentler rhythm
advice: Discuss instructor availability, experience level and your preferred session length before choosing a stay. Sessions are optional planning ideas, not included treatments or guaranteed activities.

name: Scenic Sri Lanka
description: Combine changing landscapes and cultural stops into a scenic introduction to the island.
heading: From ancient landscapes to the ocean
advice: Allow breathing room for viewpoints and changing weather. A hill-country rail segment can be discussed, with road travel as an alternative if suitable seats are unavailable.

name: Beyond the Ordinary Sri Lanka
description: Culture, hill country and coastal discoveries in one varied island journey.
heading: An island introduction with room to explore
advice: Ask about group size, departure dates and the balance of shared activities and free time.

name: Southern Riviera
description: Follow the southern coastline through heritage streets, seaside stays and unhurried beach days.
heading: Slow days along the southern coast
advice: Choose the coast and season with your planner. Beach conditions and boat excursions need local confirmation.

name: Sri Lanka & The Maldives Tour
description: Pair a Sri Lankan cultural journey with a separately arranged Maldives island extension.
heading: Sri Lankan discoveries before an island escape
advice: This suggested route covers Sri Lanka only. Maldives flights, entry requirements, resort stays and transfers must be arranged and quoted separately.

name: Sri Lanka Ramayana Tour
description: Explore places associated with Ramayana traditions alongside the scenery of the central hills.
heading: A journey through living traditions
advice: Discuss the specific religious sites you want to visit with a specialist guide. Traditions and access arrangements vary between sites.

name: Sri Lanka’s Big Five Game
description: Build a wildlife-focused journey around park landscapes and a coastal stay.
heading: Wild landscapes and ocean horizons
advice: Wildlife sightings are never guaranteed. Confirm park access, ethical guiding and seasonal suitability for any marine excursion.

name: Sri Lankan Rendezvous
description: Share a relaxed escape through tea country, scenic hills and the southern coast.
heading: Time together from hills to sea
advice: Allow restful afternoons and discuss private transfers and your preferred stays before confirming arrangements.

name: Sustainable Luxury
description: Travel thoughtfully with longer stays, local experiences and space to enjoy each landscape.
heading: A slower, more considered island journey
advice: Ask accommodation providers about their environmental practices and choose locally guided experiences. Sustainability claims should be checked with each provider.

name: The Colonial Golf Clubs of Ceylon
description: Combine golf interests with Colombo, Kandy and the cool scenery of the central highlands.
heading: Fairways and hill-country stays
advice: Tee times, visitor access, dress codes, equipment and green fees need separate confirmation with each club.

name: Honeymoon Collection
description: Create a personal honeymoon with hill-country hideaways, heritage walks and quiet coastal days.
heading: Your own romantic island escape
advice: Share your preferred pace and stay style. Special dinners, room upgrades and private activities are requests to confirm, not included services.

name: Trails & Treks Tour Sri Lanka
description: Make walking the heart of your journey through forests, river landscapes and hill country.
heading: Explore the island on foot
advice: Choose trails with a local guide around your fitness, weather and access rules. Confirm permits and suitable equipment before setting out.

name: Travel like a local
description: Discover everyday Sri Lanka through neighbourhood walks, local food and time in smaller communities.
heading: Everyday moments, memorable places
advice: Discuss locally hosted experiences and public transport options. Train reservations, community visits and meal arrangements must be confirmed.

name: Wrecks & Reefs
description: Plan a coastal escape around your interest in underwater landscapes and time beside the ocean.
heading: Coastal days above and below the water
advice: Choose a licensed dive operator and a coast suited to your travel dates. Certification, medical suitability, sea conditions and dive sites require operator confirmation.
